desc: Select monotonic-stack contribution counting as the primary approach.
Implement deterministic tie-breaking and boundary arrays for minima and maxima.
Implement O(1) bounded-length pair-count helper for left/right extensions.
Implement minimum-contribution pass using previous strictly smaller and next smaller-or-equal boundaries.
Implement maximum-contribution pass using previous strictly larger and next larger-or-equal boundaries.
Combine contributions and handle negative values and large totals.
Validate against examples and edge cases: k=1, k=n, duplicates, all negative, all equal.
